title: Deleting Apps
drDigitalIntro:
Delete apps you no longer use to keep your device tidy and free up space.
• Find the app in My Apps and click Delete.
• Your data is usually saved to the cloud, so you can reinstall for free later.
• Deleting built-in apps (like Mail or Files) is generally not allowed — they are part of the system.

playgroundTask.goal: You deleted an app you no longer need

steps.say: Go to My Apps to see your installed apps.
Find FlashLight and click the Delete button to remove it.

drDigitalSuccess: You deleted an app! You can always reinstall it for free from the App Market later.
drDigitalHint: Go to My Apps, find the app you want to remove, and click the Delete button.
